variants.name: 清爽扁平
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished landscape icon concept sheet with TWO matching marks side by side, generous transparent padding, no text anywhere. Subject: 湫 (Qiu), the white-haired teenage boy from the animated film Big Fish & Begonia / 大鱼海棠, sitting naturally on a friendly whale's back, both in side profile. The boy has short windswept white hair, a dark teal simple tunic and a quiet warm expression; legs hang to one side. This is a desktop productivity plugin icon for 'QiuYa 增强工具箱'. LEFT: an elegant simplified flat app icon, navy and turquoise whale with ivory belly, white-haired boy, smooth large silhouettes, subtle ocean-blue rounded-square tile behind the subject. Whale fills most of the tile, curved tail lifted, boy clearly seated on its back. RIGHT: the exact same composition redrawn as a compact TRUE BLACK AND WHITE menu mark, solid black shapes with white negative-space hair/belly, no gray, no gradient, no surrounding tile. Preserve the recognizable boy-on-whale silhouette while removing tiny facial/clothing details so it reads at 20–24px. Minimal clean vector-like edges, limited details, premium calm friendly feel. No waves, bubbles, extra characters, lettering, watermark or mockup devices. Transparent sheet outside left icon tile and right mark.
